translation = "The natural monument of the town is a 0.15 km sand stone information marked by severe water erosion, which in this area is also referred to as Magura-Flysch."

tr_m = re.search(r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(ha|hectares?|km|m|cm|kg|%)\b", translation)

unit_changed = (src_unit != tr_unit) and not (src_unit == "ha" and tr_unit.startswith("hectare"))

# Antonym/negation check
neg_src = bool(re.search(r"\bnicht|kein", source))
neg_tr = bool(re.search(r"\bnot\b|\bno\b|n't", translation))

expected = "B" if unit_changed else "UNKNOWN"

if expected == claimed:

elif expected == "UNKNOWN":
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
